main.description: Whether and with whom the athlete's activities may be grouped with other athletes' (feed/group-activities). Lives only in the athlete's self space (app.activitytracker.space.athlete, key self), never in the public repo. No record means the athlete was never asked, and grouping is off. While it isn't off, clients write an app.activitytracker.feed.segmentTrack for each activity with a track. The AppView indexes it from self, never serves it, and drops the athlete's pairs when it says off.

mode.description: off: never grouped. connected: grouped only with opted-in athletes they follow or who follow them. anyone: grouped with any opted-in athlete. An unknown value counts as off.
